first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the current completion decline and has replicated evidence of durable activation and faster time-to-value. Promotional pricing could counter the competitor, but its known 30-day retention harm conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue; verify that tradeoff alongside the most directly relevant onboarding evidence before committing.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment only for simple self-serve accounts, explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts and monitoring activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 60-day churn. This directly addresses falling onboarding completion and activation while respecting the verified churn risk. Promotional pricing is rejected because its verified first-renewal retention loss conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
